note: Formats every drive the board selects (WITH_<drive>_S, chosen at compile time from the board macro, not detected), then mounts each, makes three folders and writes one file in each, reads the files back, prints them and lists every drive twice. Each drive has its own three quotes: F1-F3 on /sdcard, F4-F6 on /sdnand, F7-F9 on /flash. A failing FatFs call prints '<call> erreur <n>' and spins, so the run stops there. File dates read 29-02-2024 because the RTC is not set after a reset. The process exits at the end and the console stays.

expect: ^F1: The old dreams were good dreams\.
^F3: I didn't know he was dead
^F6: I am not afraid of death
